wood.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL 2D pixel game modular interior north-wall panel, to integrate into this project's 26-pixel tile medieval RPG. Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: the prior original project stone-wall atlas. Input image 2 is a STYLE AND SCALE REFERENCE ONLY: the current bellhouse preview. Generate a NEW wooden bellhouse interior wall, NOT a room, NOT a floor, NOT a UI mockup. Overall silhouette a long shallow rectangle about 6 times wider than tall, resting on one straight horizontal baseline. Texture details small enough to remain coherent after nearest-neighbor reduction. Uniform diffuse light from upper left; no glow, no cast shadow outside the object. No doors, windows, arches, holes, furniture, props, text, labels, border or watermark. Entire wall visible, centered with generous TRANSPARENT padding, genuine transparent background; nothing behind it. No perspective convergence, no isometric diagonal walls, no floor slab. The result is a production source for a nonwalkable boundary, not a finished level.

No floor slab, no water, rubble, candles, props, furniture, doors, windows, arch gaps, text, labels, border, UI or watermark.
